title: Healthy Energy Bars
description: No-bake energy bars made from dried mixed fruit, nuts and pitted dates. Great for an elevenses snack and freezable for up to 2 months.

ingredients.text: 200g dried mixed fruit (sultanas, raisins, currants or cranberries)
250g mixed nuts (cashews, walnuts, Brazil nuts, pecans)

steps: Put all the ingredients in a food processor. Pulse a few times to make crumbs, then process for another minute until the mixture starts to come together into a ball.
Line a 25cm square baking tray with greaseproof paper and transfer the mixture to the tray. Spread into the corners and flatten with a palette knife.
Refrigerate for a couple of hours, then remove and cut into bars or squares.
notes: Makes around 18 bars. Per bar estimate. Freeze for up to 2 months.
